base_experts.LONG: M15 overextension setup, two-stage M5 EMA hold confirmation, structural risk, 0.75R target, 12h horizon
base_experts.SHORT: M15 overextension setup, two-stage M5 retest-break confirmation, structural risk, 1R target, 4h horizon

schedule: retrain at each calendar month start using only events fully resolved before that month
monthly_switch: OFF unless the immediately prior validation segment has at least 8 admitted trades, WR >= 0.60, PF >= 2.0 and positive mean R
thresholds: score-quantile gates selected in the prior validation segment only
execution: apply gate to raw trigger events, then one-open admission with open state carried across months
features: entry-known setup, higher-timeframe context, setup-to-confirmation path and M5 confirmation features
